accounting.accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounting.accounts.description: Accounts shared by every legal entity; only postable accounts take entries.
accounting.accounts.empty_description: Add the accounts of the chart to start booking.
accounting.account.name: Account name
accounting.account.parent_hint: Of the same type; leave empty for a top-level account.
accounting.account.active_hint: A retired account takes no new entries.
accounting.rules.title: Mapping rules
accounting.rules.description: Each kind of business line is booked to one account, on the debit or credit side.
accounting.starts.title: Start dates
accounting.starts.description: The day each legal entity starts using accounting; documents before it never reach the ledger.
accounting.starts.empty_description: Add legal entities to the org tree under Administration.
accounting.start.date_hint: Leave empty while the legal entity does not use accounting. It is fixed once there are entries.
accounting.pending.title: Awaiting posting
accounting.pending.description: Documents posted in their product that have not reached the ledger, and why.
accounting.pending.posted: Pending documents queued for posting. Refresh in a moment to see the result.
accounting.pending.empty_description: Every document of the legal entity has reached the ledger.
accounting.entries.title: Journal entries
accounting.entries.description: Entries made by hand; automatic entries are in the general ledger.
accounting.entries.create_description: Enter the debit and credit lines; debits must equal credits when posted.
accounting.entries.empty_description: Journal entries record what no business document books.
accounting.entry.section.general_hint: Date, legal entity and what the entry is for.
accounting.entry.section.lines_hint: Each line books an amount on one side, debit or credit, to a postable account.
accounting.entry.section.lines_hint_ro: The entry's debit and credit lines.
accounting.line.title: Line {{n}}
accounting.ledger.title: General ledger
accounting.ledger.description_text: An account's movements over a range with its balance; a parent includes its children.
accounting.ledger.pick_description: Choose a legal entity and an account to see its ledger.
accounting.trial.title: Trial balance
accounting.trial.description: Each account's opening balance, movements and closing balance; parents add up their children.
accounting.trial.name: Account name
accounting.trial.empty_description: The legal entity has no entries yet.
accounting.start.fixed_hint: The legal entity has entries, so its start date can no longer change.
